svg.text: Crates N' Plates — Entity Relationship Diagram
Logical ERD over Firebase Realtime Database · node paths shown in each header · PK = node key · FK = stored reference (no enforced joins)
No FK: reservations are matched to orders by phone.
RTDB is schemaless: line items, payments, favorites and add-ons are embedded; orders → sales is a deliberate denormalised copy for reporting.
